text:
A car is moving along a straight horizontal road. The car has 1.6MJ of kinetic energy. The car
accelerates for 20s until the kinetic energy of the car increases to 2.5MJ.
What is the minimum average power developed by the car engine for this acceleration?
A
45W
B
205W
C
45kW
D
205kW
subject: Physics
